question: What is the expected investment target under the Tamil Nadu Space Industrial Policy 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹10,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu government has set an ambitious target of attracting **₹10,000 crore investments** under its Tamil Nadu Space Industrial Policy 2025.
 
• The policy aims to position Tamil Nadu as a hub for **space industry and research**, leveraging the state’s strong industrial base and technological ecosystem.
 
• It seeks to promote growth in the **space sector**, including areas like satellite manufacturing, launch services, and ground station operations.
 
• The policy also focuses on fostering **innovation** by encouraging start-ups and academic institutions to participate in the space ecosystem.
 
• It is aligned with India’s vision of becoming a major player in the global **space economy** by enhancing domestic capabilities and infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Space Economy in India:**

 
 
• India’s space economy is valued at approximately $9.6 billion, which is about 2% of the global space economy.
 
• It includes segments such as satellite services, ground equipment, and manufacturing.
 
• India’s space program is spearheaded by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), which has achieved several milestones globally.
 
 
 
• **Global Space Industry Trends:**
 
 
• The global space economy is expected to reach $1 trillion by 2040, driven by advancements in satellite technology and private sector investments.
 
• Key players include SpaceX, Blue Origin, and government agencies like NASA, ESA, and Roscosmos.
 
 
 
• **Indian Space Start-ups:**
 
 
• India has seen a surge in private space start-ups like Skyroot Aerospace, Agnikul Cosmos, and Pixxel.
 
• These start-ups focus on areas such as small satellite launches, payload development, and data analytics.
 
 
 
• **Key Objectives of Tamil Nadu Space Industrial Policy:**
 
 
• To develop world-class infrastructure for space-related industries.
 
• To attract investments in research, development, and manufacturing.
 
• To generate employment opportunities in the high-tech sector.
 
• To collaborate with ISRO and other global space agencies.
